description: This header file defines classes and templates for registering operators in the PyTorch C++ backend, including options for schema, kernels, and dispatch keys.

classes.name: RegisterOperators
classes.description: Class responsible for registering operators with various options, including schema, kernels, and alias analysis.

methods.name: checkSchemaAndRegisterOp_
methods.description: Validates and registers the operator schema and associated kernels.

methods.name: inferSchemaFromKernels_
methods.description: Infers the operator schema from registered kernels.

methods.name: checkNoDuplicateKernels_
methods.description: Checks for duplicate kernel registrations for the same dispatch key.

methods.name: registerOp_
methods.description: Finalizes the registration of the operator with specified options.
